n0856f666a4.headline: Google's Alphabet company adopts unique technology to provide Internet service, using balloons' help - Googles Alphabet Company Adopts Unique Technology to Provide Internet Service Lee Helps Balloons Jagran Special
n0856f666a4.summary: Google's Alphabet company has used balloons to provide internet service in Nairobi, marking the first experiment of its kind in the region.
n0856f666a4.why: Innovative internet delivery methods can improve connectivity and digital economy growth in underserved regions.
